inputs.frame_convention: Millimeter XYZ in the common calibration reference frame identified by native target device/socket metadata. SupportPlane supplied in build or ParcelDetectorConfig uses those same coordinates. The reference camera must be above the surface; either normal sign is accepted. Native PointCloud uses DEFAULT coordinates, calibrated translation, and an identity custom transform. Other producers must normalize XYZ and metadata to this frame. The capture interval and device clock must be shared. Use delivered-grid calibration and the evaluated unrectified source-image profile; other grids can change eligibility despite correct calibration.

image_profile.resolution_check: Once per detector instance after valid scene message types; warn with all expected and received sizes on mismatch, then continue processing. User override of updated handoff rejection policy.
image_profile.geometry_policy: Preserve native field of view, orientation, and unrectified geometry. Dimensions alone do not verify these properties. No automatic resize, crop, rectification, or threshold scaling. Other profiles have no equivalence guarantee.

preferred_neural_depth.validation: Upstream recommendation only; ParcelDetector receives PointCloudData, not a depth image.

inputs.support_plane_configuration: Optional SupportPlane in build, default None. While unset, consume and discard synchronized groups without scene decoding, algorithm execution or outputs. ParcelDetectorConfig supplies the plane and activates subsequent groups without restarting. Config messages still require a real SupportPlane.
